- **#4412**: a glitch in the driver text prompt when combine trailers are staged on the overflow lots. Source: the same Moss digest.
- **#8841**: West yard Door 2 is being double-booked. Tobias logged it in #central-random on 13 Oct. An older Central weekly used #8841 for a Tansley Parcel printer jam, so it's worth confirming the number with him.
- **PD-5302**: a follow-up ticket from this week. Hollis posted it in #central-random on 14 Oct and said no action was needed.

I didn't find any other Fieldworks ticket numbers this week in #central-team, #general, #help-it-ops, #inc-tansley-carrier-api or our DM. I left out FR-882, which is a Marrow Agrisupply request, and #4419 from Moss's North notes, which is a Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket.

I only searched channels you're in and files you can open. The knowledge brain also turned up Marrow Fieldworks tickets in sources outside what you asked for, so I left those off the list.
